passages.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
passages.sermon:
Beloved, do not believe every spirit.
Test the spirits.
See if the spirits are from God.
Many false prophets have gone out into the world.
passages.original: Ἀγαπητοί μὴ παντὶ πνεύματι πιστεύετε ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζετε τὰ πνεύματα εἰ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ὅτι πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐξεληλύθασιν εἰς τὸν κόσμον

passages.text: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God, and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
passages.sermon:
The Spirit of God has a clear sign.
Every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ has come in the flesh comes from God.
Every spirit that does not confess Jesus does not come from God.
This spirit is the spirit of the antichrist.
You have heard that the antichrist is coming.
Now the antichrist is already in the world.
passages.original: Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκετε τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Θεοῦ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ ὁμολογεῖ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ μὴ ὁμολογεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου ὃ ἀκηκόατε ὅτι ἔρχεται καὶ νῦν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν ἤδη

passages.text: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
passages.sermon:
You are children of God.
God is your Father.
You belong to God.
You have overcome the false prophets.
God lives in you.
God is greater than the one who is in the world.
The one in the world is not as great as God.
God’s power in you is stronger than the world’s power.
passages.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστε τεκνία καὶ νενικήκατε αὐτούς ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν ἢ ὁ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ

passages.text: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
passages.sermon: They belong to the world.\r\nThey speak from the world’s point of view.\r\nThe world listens to them.
passages.original: αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου εἰσίν διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου λαλοῦσιν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν ἀκούει

passages.text: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
passages.sermon:
We are from God.
People who know God listen to us.
People who are not from God do not listen to us.
This is how we know the Spirit of truth.
This is how we know the spirit of deception.
passages.original: ἡμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐσμεν ὁ γινώσκων τὸν Θεὸν ἀκούει ἡμῶν ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἀκούει ἡμῶν ἐκ τούτου γινώσκομεν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πλάνης

passages.text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
passages.sermon:
Beloved, let us love one another.
Love comes from God.
Everyone who loves has been born of God.
Everyone who loves knows God.
passages.original: Ἀγαπητοί ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ γινώσκει τὸν Θεόν

passages.text: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
passages.sermon: God is love.\r\nA person who does not love does not know God.
passages.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν Θεόν ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν

passages.text: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
passages.sermon:
God is love.
God showed His love to us.
God sent His only Son into the world.
God did this so we can live through His Son.
passages.original: Ἐν τούτῳ ἐφανερώθη ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν ὅτι τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ ἀπέσταλκεν ὁ Θεὸς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα ζήσωμεν δι’ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
passages.sermon:
God is love.
Love does not begin with us loving God.
Love begins with God loving us.
God showed His love for us.
God sent His Son.
God’s Son is Jesus Christ.
God sent Jesus as an atoning sacrifice.
Jesus died for our sins.
God’s love is shown by sending Jesus for us.
passages.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη οὐχ ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠγαπήκαμεν τὸν Θεόν ἀλλ’ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν

passages.text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
passages.sermon: God loved us in a great way.\r\nWe are His beloved people.\r\nBecause God loved us like this, we must love one another.
passages.original: Ἀγαπητοί εἰ οὕτως ὁ Θεὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν

passages.text: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
passages.sermon: No one has ever seen God.\r\nIf we love one another, God lives in us.\r\nHis love is made complete in us.
passages.original: Θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ τετελειωμένη ἐν ἡμῖν ἐστιν

passages.text: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
passages.sermon:
God gives us His Spirit.
We know that we remain in God because of this.
God also remains in us.
God’s Spirit in us shows this truth.
passages.original: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένομεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν

passages.text: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
passages.sermon:
We have seen this truth.
We testify about it.
The Father sent His Son.
His Son is the Savior of the world.
passages.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν Υἱὸν Σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου

passages.text: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
passages.sermon: Anyone can confess that Jesus is the Son of God.\r\nGod lives in that person.\r\nThat person lives in God.
passages.original: Ὃς ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ Θεῷ

passages.text: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
passages.sermon:
God loves us.
We have come to know this love.
We have believed this love.
God is love.
Anyone who remains in love remains in God.
God remains in that person.
passages.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν Ὁ Θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει

passages.text: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
passages.sermon:
God is love.
God has shown His love to us.
God has made His love complete among us.
God did this so we can have confidence on the day of judgment.
We can stand without fear when God judges the world.
We are like Jesus in this world.
God wants us to live as Jesus lived.
passages.original: Ἐν τούτῳ τετελείωται ἡ ἀγάπη μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἵνα παρρησίαν ἔχωμεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς κρίσεως ὅτι καθὼς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ

passages.text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
passages.sermon:
God is love.
Love comes from God.
There is no fear in love.
Perfect love drives out fear.
Fear involves punishment.
Anyone who fears has not been made perfect in love.
passages.original: Φόβος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἀλλ’ ἡ τελεία ἀγάπη ἔξω βάλλει τὸν φόβον ὅτι ὁ φόβος κόλασιν ἔχει ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος οὐ τετελείωται ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ

passages.text: We love because He first loved us.
passages.sermon: God loved us first.\r\nWe love because of His love for us.
passages.original: Ἡμεῖς ἀγαπῶμεν ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς

passages.text: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
passages.sermon:
If a person says, "I love God," but hates his brother, he is a liar.
A person cannot love God if he does not love his brother.
A person has seen his brother.
A person has not seen God.
If a person does not love his brother, whom he has seen, he cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
passages.original: Ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὅτι Ἀγαπῶ τὸν Θεόν καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῇ ψεύστης ἐστίν ὁ γὰρ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν ἑώρακεν τὸν Θεὸν ὃν οὐχ ἑώρακεν οὐ δύναται ἀγαπᾶν

passages.text: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
passages.sermon:
God gave us a commandment.
This commandment comes from Him.
Whoever loves God must also love his brother.
God requires us to love both Him and our brothers.
passages.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔχομεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἵνα ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν Θεὸν ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ
